notes: Two routes of the same saying, joined by «وحدثنا» (no «ح»): they meet only in the text's «عن عباية بن رفاعة، عن رافع بن خديج», written once, so that is the shared tail.
The two «سعيد بن مسروق» are two occurrences of the name, one per route (Sufyan's teacher and Za'ida's teacher): not merged.
The archive flag (three or more routes) is answered by the reading: two routes only.
